verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for an enterprise voice AI SaaS platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region. The only related item says enterprise customers get dedicated, isolated infrastructure. That describes tenant isolation, not a choice of where data is stored, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
